class_size_limits_001.evidence: ARTICLE XVI ELEMENTARY CLASS SIZE Any regular elementary classroom in an elementary school that has one (1) or more students over the maximum enrollment specified in the School District Policy shall have a district employed aide or certified employee to assist at least one (1) hour per day per overload student enrolled.
